cards.text: I cut my teeth on wedding rings in the movies
cards.translation: 我在电影里的婚戒世界中完成了最初的历练

cards.text: We crave a different kind of buzz
cards.translation: 我们渴望另一种兴奋感

cards.text: The hounds will stay in chains
cards.translation: 猎犬们会被锁在链中

cards.text: Call all the ladies out, they're in their finery
cards.translation: 把所有女士都请出来，她们身着华服

cards.text: Now bring my boys in, their skin in craters like the moon
cards.translation: 现在带我的人进来，他们的皮肤像月球表面一样坑坑洼洼

cards.text: Even the comatose, they don't dance and tell
cards.translation: 就连昏睡的人，也不会起舞也不会说出去

cards.text: Shards beneath our feet
cards.translation: 我们脚下的碎片

cards.text: I'm kind of older than I was when I reveled without a care
cards.translation: 我比从前那个肆意狂欢、无忧无虑的自己老了些

cards.text: Pumped up on the little bright things I bought
cards.translation: 被我买的那些闪亮小玩意刺激得兴奋不已

cards.text: Baby, be the class clown, I'll be the beauty queen in tears
cards.translation: 宝贝，你来当班里的活宝，我来当流泪的选美皇后

cards.text: Everything's cool when we're all in line for the throne
cards.translation: 当我们都在排队争夺王位时，一切都好

cards.text: We're hollow like the bottles that we drain
cards.translation: 我们空空如也，就像被我们喝干的瓶子

cards.text: You drape your wrists over the steering wheel
cards.translation: 你把手腕搭在方向盘上

cards.text: I'm glad that we stopped kissing the tar on the highway
cards.translation: 我很高兴我们不再亲吻高速公路上的柏油

cards.text: It kissed your scalp and caressed your brain
cards.translation: 它吻过你的头皮，爱抚过你的大脑

cards.text: Took a shiner from the fist of your best friend
cards.translation: 挨了你最好朋友一拳，眼眶乌青

cards.text: Roughing up our minds so we're ready when the killtime comes

keyWords.meaning_cn: 磨砺，粗暴对待（原形 rough up）

cards.translation: 磨砺我们的头脑，好在杀戮时刻来临时有备无患

cards.text: My blood is a flood of rubies, precious stones
cards.translation: 我的血液是红宝石的洪流，珍贵宝石

cards.text: And the shivers move down my shoulder blades in double time
cards.translation: 颤栗顺着我的肩胛骨飞快地滑下

cards.text: But I got my fingers laced together and I made a little prison
cards.translation: 但我十指相扣，造了一座小小监狱

cards.text: I'm locking up everyone that ever laid a finger on me

keyWords.meaning_cn: 动过…一根手指，冒犯过（原形 lay a finger on）

cards.translation: 我把每个碰过我一根手指的人都锁起来

cards.text: Watch the wasters blow the speakers
cards.translation: 看那些废柴把音响烧到爆

cards.text: Spill my guts beneath the outdoor light
cards.translation: 在户外灯光下倾诉心事

cards.text: It's just another graceless night
cards.translation: 这不过是又一个狼狈失态的夜晚

cards.text: This is how we get notorious
cards.translation: 我们就是这样声名狼藉的

cards.text: All the nights spent off our faces

keyWords.meaning_cn: 烂醉如泥，嗨到失去神智

cards.translation: 那些烂醉如泥的夜晚

cards.text: Played it so nonchalant
cards.translation: 装得如此满不在乎

cards.text: Go astray with me?
cards.translation: 跟我一起偏离正道可好？

cards.text: Can we keep up with the ruse?
cards.translation: 我们还能维持这场骗局吗？

cards.text: Till daylight, we're jaded
cards.translation: 直到天亮，我们都已精疲力竭

cards.text: And the treason, the fantasies of leaving
cards.translation: 还有那背叛，那出走的幻想

cards.text: Let's let things come out of the woodwork
cards.translation: 让那些藏起来的东西统统冒出来吧

cards.text: Blowing things up with homemade dynamite
cards.translation: 用自制的炸药把一切炸上天

cards.text: When you've outgrown a lover

keyWords.meaning_cn: 不再适合、超越（原形 outgrow）

cards.translation: 当一个爱人已配不上你

cards.text: I still remember everything, how we'd drift buying groceries
cards.translation: 我仍记得一切，记得我们买杂货时信步游荡

cards.text: Bet you rue the day you kissed a writer in the dark
cards.translation: 我赌你会悔不当初，在黑暗中吻了一位作家

cards.text: But in our darkest hours, I stumbled on a secret power

keyWords.meaning_cn: 偶然发现（原形 stumble on）

cards.translation: 但在我们最黑暗的时刻，我偶然发现了一种神秘力量

cards.text: I still feel you, now and then
cards.translation: 我仍会不时感觉到你

cards.text: But when the heat comes, something takes a hold
cards.translation: 可当热浪袭来，某种东西攫住了我

cards.text: And I throw my cellular device in the water
cards.translation: 我把手机扔进水里

cards.text: Got a wishbone drying on the windowsill in my kitchen
cards.translation: 我厨房窗台上晾着一块如愿骨

cards.text: Maybe I'm just stoned at the nail salon again
cards.translation: 也许我只是又在美甲店吸嗨了

cards.text: We'd go dancing all over the landmines under our town
cards.translation: 我们会在小镇地下的雷区上起舞

cards.text: Two former hell-raisers
cards.translation: 两个昔日的小混世魔王

cards.text: I'd ride and I'd ride on the carousel
cards.translation: 我会骑着旋转木马转啊转

cards.text: Now all of my oceans have riptides
cards.translation: 如今我所有的海洋都有暗流涌动

cards.text: Ladies, begin your sun salutations
cards.translation: 女士们，开始你们的拜日式吧

cards.text: You can burn sage, and I'll cleanse the crystals
cards.translation: 你烧鼠尾草，我来净化水晶

cards.text: I'll find my own bravado
cards.translation: 我会找到属于自己的逞强姿态

cards.text: I was fighting off every little thing that I thought was out to get me down

keyWords.meaning_cn: 奋力抵御（原形 fight off）

cards.translation: 我在抵御每一件我以为存心想击垮我的小事

cards.text: Listen to the beats resound
cards.translation: 听那节拍回荡

cards.text: All the double-edged people and schemes
cards.translation: 那些两面三刀之人与种种算计

cards.text: God knows we like archaic kinds of fun
cards.translation: 天知道我们就爱这种老掉牙的乐子

cards.text: We roll in every summer when strength in our numbers

keyWords.meaning_cn: 成群涌到（原形 roll in）

cards.translation: 每年夏天我们都会浩浩荡荡杀回来，人多力量大

cards.text: Because no one can be bothered when it's humid like this
cards.translation: 因为天闷成这样，谁也提不起劲

cards.text: Not in the swing of things yet
cards.translation: 还没找回状态呢

cards.text: Their likeness set in stone
cards.translation: 他们的雕像凝固在石头里

cards.text: But my head's fillin' up fast with the wicked games, up in flames
cards.translation: 可我脑中飞速填满邪恶游戏，一切烧成灰烬

cards.text: I'm in a clique but I want out
cards.translation: 我混在一个小圈子里，但我想退出

cards.text: And the girls get the claws out

keyWords.meaning_cn: 亮出爪子，恶语相向（原形 claw）

cards.translation: 姑娘们亮出利爪互相撕咬

cards.text: Pound the prairie pavement, losing proposition

keyWords.meaning_cn: 四处奔波（pound the pavement 习语）

cards.translation: 在草原公路上疲于奔命，一桩赔本买卖

cards.text: I'll give you my best side, tell you all my best lies
cards.translation: 我会把最好的一面给你，把最动听的谎话说给你听

cards.text: We were wild and fluorescent, come home to my heart
cards.translation: 我们曾狂野又耀眼，回到我心上吧

cards.text: I am your sweetheart psychopathic crush
cards.translation: 我是你的甜心，也是你疯狂痴迷的执念

cards.text: All that mystery and beauty gleaned from desert flowers and gifted children

keyWords.meaning_cn: 点滴搜集、领悟（原形 glean）

cards.translation: 所有从沙漠之花与天才孩童身上搜集来的神秘与美

cards.text: Now I'm alone on a windswept island
cards.translation: 如今我独自一人待在狂风肆虐的岛上

cards.text: Caught in the complex divorce of the seasons
cards.translation: 被卷入四季之间错综复杂的离异

cards.text: Psychedelic garlands in our hair
cards.translation: 发间戴着迷幻的花环

cards.text: Through the halls of splendor where the apple trees all grew
cards.translation: 穿过苹果树曾经繁盛的华美殿堂

cards.text: Your emotional baggage can be picked up at carousel number two
cards.translation: 你的情感包袱请到二号行李传送带领取

cards.text: Mixed with existential vertigo
cards.translation: 混合着存在主义的眩晕

cards.text: Dutifully fallin' apart for the Princess of Norway
cards.translation: 恪尽职守地为挪威公主心碎崩溃

cards.text: Go all New Age, outrunning your blues
cards.translation: 彻底拥抱新时代，把忧郁甩在身后

cards.text: Then I watch you flick them down like dominoes
cards.translation: 然后我看着你像推倒多米诺骨牌一样把它们弹倒

cards.text: I toss up if it's worth it, now, every time I get on a plane
cards.translation: 如今每次登机，我都在掂量这到底值不值

cards.text: Shivering pines and walls of colour, I can't believe I used to stay inside
cards.translation: 颤动的松林和斑斓的墙，难以置信我从前竟一直待在屋里

cards.text: Made it to the island on the last of the outbound planes
cards.translation: 搭上最后一班离港飞机到了岛上

cards.text: Another day lost and paranoia reigns supreme
cards.translation: 又荒废了一天，猜疑之心甚嚣尘上

cards.text: My dreamer's disposition or my wicked streak?
cards.translation: 是我爱做梦的天性，还是我骨子里的邪性？

cards.text: Now the cherry black lipstick's gathering dust in a drawer
cards.translation: 如今那支樱桃黑口红在抽屉里积灰

cards.text: On the beach I'm buildin' a pyre
cards.translation: 在沙滩上我堆起一座火葬柴堆

cards.text: It's a beautiful life, so why play truant?
cards.translation: 生活如此美好，何必逃避？

cards.text: I wear smoke like a wedding veil
cards.translation: 我把烟雾当婚纱面纱般佩戴

cards.text: I see a hot mess in an antique skirt
cards.translation: 我看见一个穿着古董裙的狼狈家伙

cards.text: I've been up on the pedestal
cards.translation: 我一直被捧在神坛之上

cards.text: In love with your whim
cards.translation: 爱上了你的心血来潮

cards.text: Stood in the park under the eclipse
cards.translation: 站在公园里，头顶日食

cards.text: Be so bare in the throes
cards.translation: 在挣扎的剧痛中赤裸相对

cards.text: Mystique is dead
cards.translation: 神秘感已死

cards.text: In the gym, I'm exorcising
cards.translation: 在健身房里，我驱除心魔

cards.text: Worthy opponent, flint to my blade, now we're playing with shadows
cards.translation: 势均力敌的对手，是我刀锋上的燧石，如今我们在暗影中博弈

cards.text: 'Cause you dimed me out when it got hard

keyWords.meaning_cn: 告发出卖（原形 dime out）

cards.translation: 因为情况一艰难你就把我卖了

cards.text: Pure heroine mistaken for featherweight
cards.translation: 纯正的女英雄被误当作无足轻重的轻量级

cards.text: Was I just young blood to get on tape?
cards.translation: 难道我只是你上镜用的年轻血肉？
